item.title: [LU-21267] TCU: Server nodes continously crashing due kernel panic -> BUG: kernel NULL pointer dereference
item.description:
When a single storage controller experienced a crash [Fault Injection] , an attempt to restore files from the trash can initiated a cascading kernel panic crash. Specifically, this action caused two Lustre nodes to crash repeatedly in an infinite crash loop, rendering the affected storage paths inaccessible and destabilizing the cluster.
